backpack n
/ˈbækpæk/
حقيبة ظهر
a bag you carry on your back. You put your books in it.

class n
/klæs/
فصل · حصة
a group of students with a teacher. Also the lesson time.
★ He can take the present to class.
paper n
/ˈpeɪpər/

ruler n
/ˈruːlər/
